goal: Admit only causal catalog-derived do-block routine edits while retaining exact collision keys and every existing DDL refusal.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken, bypass, delete, or allowlist around structural admission or collision checks.
Do not change PR #2818 or any migration.
Do not read from or write to a shared database.
Do not alter another session's PR, branch, claim, worktree, or reviewer lease.
assumptions: A qualifying edit reads one schema-qualified regprocedure definition into a variable, then mutates that same variable with replace or regexp_replace, then executes that same variable.
Quoted SQL text and comments must not satisfy mutation or execution evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop if the do-block pattern cannot return an exact routine collision key.
Stop if comment-only, string-only, out-of-order, unedited, data-only, or unmodelled-DDL inputs become admissible.
Stop if the repair requires changing PR #2818 or a migration.
